title: Subarray sum equals k
statement:
Count the contiguous, non-empty subarrays of nums whose elements sum to k. Values may be negative.

Constraints: up to 2 × 10⁴ elements.
hints: The sum of nums[i..j] is prefix[j+1] − prefix[i].
Negative values rule out a sliding window. Count earlier prefixes equal to prefix − k with a hash map.

solution.explanation: Subarray (i, j] sums to k exactly when prefix[j] − prefix[i] = k. Scan once, keeping a count of each prefix sum seen; at each position add the number of earlier prefixes equal to prefix − k. Seed the map with {0: 1} for subarrays starting at index 0. A sliding window would fail here because negative numbers break monotonicity.
solution.python:
import collections

def subarray_sum(nums, k):
    count = 0; prefix = 0
    seen = collections.Counter({0: 1})
    for x in nums:
        prefix += x
        count += seen[prefix - k]
        seen[prefix] += 1
    return count
